definitions.gloss: turning point, transition period, change of season
definitions.explanation: The point or period at which something changes from one state to another. Commonly used for seasonal transitions, life transitions, or any boundary between two different phases.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}に{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す。
examples.english: I get sick at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}が{人生|じんせい}の{変|か}わり{目|め}だと{感|かん}じている。
examples.english: I feel that now is a turning point in my life.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}は{風邪|かぜ}をひきやすいので、{服装|ふくそう}に{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: You tend to catch colds at the change of seasons, so please be careful about what you wear.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the phrase {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め} (change of seasons), which is a very frequent expression in daily Japanese. The word conveys the idea of an in-between period when things are shifting. It can also apply to life stages, eras, and other transitions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}: change of seasons
- {人生|じんせい}の{変|か}わり{目|め}: turning point in life
- {時代|じだい}の{変|か}わり{目|め}: turning point of an era
- {変|か}わり{目|め}に{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す: to fall ill at a transitional period
